AboutPage.title: About Oaziland
AboutPage.intro: Oaziland is a Glorentech™ platform, built to make finding and listing property, hotels, hostels, and venues across Cameroon simple, verified, and trustworthy.
AboutPage.missionText: To connect landlords, agents, agencies, and everyday people directly and safely — whether you're renting, buying, selling, or booking a stay.
AboutPage.basedText: Headquartered in Messassi, Yaoundé, and built for the way people actually search for property and services here — including WhatsApp-first communication and Mobile Money payments.
